measurement_caveat: The NumPy evaluator executes dense matrix products. Traffic is a logical float32 weight-read count; it excludes indexes, activations, and measured DRAM traffic. For blocked runs the serialized/native implementation uses 64-byte-aligned access units, but the trace evaluator is still not a latency measurement.

basis.title: Efficient LLM Inference using Dynamic Input Pruning and Cache-Aware Masking

method.engram_extension: After partial gate/up scoring, complete omitted input-coordinate products only for candidates and exactly rerank their full contribution-magnitude scores.

scope_caveat: This clean-state trace screen does not measure hidden-state drift, logit KL, target NLL, or top-1 agreement; the trained-teacher causal intervention remains decisive.
